evals.prompt: All my deps are probably stale. Update the NuGet packages, dotnet tools, and pre-commit hooks in this repo. Show me what you'd run and what files would change.
evals.expected_output: Structured plan/execution covering dotnet-outdated for NuGet, dotnet tool update for local tools, pre-commit autoupdate for hooks, and a debug build validation. Does not touch app release version fields.

assertions.name: mentions dotnet-outdated
assertions.description: Response includes the dotnet-outdated command for NuGet package updates

assertions.name: mentions pre-commit autoupdate
assertions.description: Response includes the pre-commit autoupdate command for hook revisions

assertions.name: uses --local flag
assertions.description: Response uses 'dotnet tool update --local' (with --local flag) — not bare 'dotnet tool update' which would target the global manifest

assertions.name: covers all three dep types
assertions.description: Response addresses NuGet packages, dotnet tools, AND pre-commit hooks — not just one or two

assertions.name: no app version mutation
assertions.description: Response does not suggest changing <Version>, <AssemblyVersion>, <FileVersion>, or Identity Version

assertions.name: includes build validation
assertions.description: Response includes a dotnet build command to validate after updating

evals.prompt: My pre-commit hooks and dotnet tool versions are probably stale. Can you update them? Also bump any outdated NuGet packages while you're at it.
evals.expected_output: Correct per-tool dotnet tool update commands, pre-commit autoupdate, dotnet-outdated for NuGet, and a validation build. Correctly identifies Directory.Packages.props as the central version file.

assertions.name: uses --local flag
assertions.description: Response uses 'dotnet tool update --local' (with --local flag) — not bare 'dotnet tool update' which targets the global manifest

assertions.name: names specific tools
assertions.description: Response names csharpier and/or minver-cli specifically

assertions.name: references Directory.Packages.props
assertions.description: Response mentions Directory.Packages.props as the central NuGet version file

assertions.name: no app version mutation
assertions.description: Response does not suggest changing <Version>, <AssemblyVersion>, <FileVersion>, or Identity Version

evals.prompt: Time to refresh dependencies before the next release. I want everything updated — NuGet, pre-commit revisions, and the local dotnet tools. What's the right order and what commands do I run?
evals.expected_output: Step-by-step ordered workflow: dotnet-outdated first, then dotnet tool update for each tool, then pre-commit autoupdate, then validation build. Notes that SDK BuildTools bump may also require TargetFramework/MaxVersionTested updates.

assertions.name: correct step ordering
assertions.description: NuGet update comes before or alongside tools/hooks — not after a build

assertions.name: uses --local flag
assertions.description: Response uses 'dotnet tool update --local' (with --local flag) — not bare 'dotnet tool update' which targets the global manifest

assertions.name: mentions SDK target consideration
assertions.description: Response mentions that an SDK BuildTools bump may require TargetFramework or MaxVersionTested updates

assertions.name: includes build validation
assertions.description: Response includes a dotnet build validation step

assertions.name: no app version mutation
assertions.description: Response does not suggest changing the app's own release version
